# a child's reservation and refreservation are charged to its parent as
# the larger of the two, not their sum (dsl_dir_set_quota_check on
# dd_used_bytes)
# covers: quota
zfs create $R/g
zfs create -o reservation=10485760 -o refreservation=10485760 $R/g/p
zfs set quota=15728640 $R/g
zfs set quota=5242880 $R/g
